edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations (directive R-32932)
    Given a request to a provided operation carries no valid credentials
    When the operation is called
    Then it answers 401
    Given a request to a provided operation comes from a role without the Write-off and posting right
    When the operation is called
    Then it answers 403
    Given a request to a provided operation names a write-off that does not exist
    When the operation is called
    Then it answers 404

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout (directive R-32933)
    Given the routing activity of WriteOffWorkflow fails on a transient error
    When the activity is retried
    Then the activity is retried under its retry policy and the outcome is recorded
    Given the routing activity does not complete within its timeout
    When the timeout elapses
    Then the activity is marked timed out and no state is written

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed status change is refused (directive R-32934)
    Given the write-off is in a state from which the status model allows no move to the requested state
    When the status change is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing changes and no queue item is written
